verdict.rationale: Recurly documents a full invoicing lifecycle with invoices as the central transaction record. Credit invoices give each credit its own distinct record with an audit trail and webhooks. Invoices can be edited after issuance to change customer notes, account notes, PO numbers, terms and due dates, which covers the memo side. Missing for 10: evidence of sequential/compliant invoice numbering, receipts, automatic delivery of invoices/credit notes to customers, explicit custom invoice fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
